edits.new: BR10 is answered by the empty-amount row and the REC-05 break list. The case list is released by contract, not by file: rwb-case reads it for SCR-02 and rwb-reporting for its measures. GET /case-list/dates/{businessDate} answers businessDate, publishStatus, rowCount and refreshedAt; GET /case-list/rows answers the paged rows in the 19-column order DF-RPT-001 to DF-RPT-019, filtered by businessDate, team, queue and product; the snapshot(page) activity takes the business date and the page and returns the same rows. A PENDING or HELD date answers its status and no rows. The PUBLISHED check answers YES when the date is RELEASED and NO otherwise. JOB-04 reads the open case accounts through GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases and the queue cut through GET /api/recovery/case/v1/queues/{queueId}/cases. The reconciliation and data-quality results are read through GET /admin/reconciliation/results and GET /admin/reconciliation/results/{resultId} on /api/recovery/source-data/v1 (API-P1-003); no lake extract, no file and no 07:30 report refresh exists (DP-17).
